Correction from last week: "1 in 7 orders traceable to marketing" was too narrow — it only counted paid campaigns. ~75-83% of 2025 orders actually have a known source (organic search, direct, social, referral); only ~14% trace to an active paid campaign specifically.

Loyalty points are expensive in Apparel for no payoff: that one category holds 85% of the program's €354k unredeemed-points liability and 23.7% redemption cost, yet members return no more often than non-members (58.5% vs 59.6%) — Electronics and Home & Living cost far less and do show a real repeat-purchase lift.

Referrals are our most under-used strength: people who refer others order 1.5-2.4x more often than everyone else in every single product category, and over 40% start referring within their first 1-3 orders — earlier than we assumed, meaning we can likely prompt for referrals sooner.
